Ask Today's sales; wait for answer
Open History in Orithos AI float
Confirm thread title appears with updated time

Send a follow-up such as and yesterday?

cases.expected: Other user's threads are not listed

cases.name: Store AI metrics highlights
steps: Confirm Last 24h requests and Top intents cards
Confirm no question/answer text in UI or network payload

cases.name: Platform AI usage page
steps: Sign in as platform operator on app.orithos.com.au
Confirm per-store requests / allow% / p95 / last seen

Today's sales still returns report path without hanging
